title: Austin ISD's deficit grew five times over
subtitle: The district's own projections for the 2025-26 deficit, as revised through the year
alt: Bar chart of the Austin Independent School District (Austin ISD) projected deficit for the 2025-26 school year as the district revised it: $19 million in the budget trustees adopted in June 2025, $49 million by February 2026, $95 million in June 2026, and $105 million in the unaudited year-end figure presented to trustees on Aug. 27, 2026
source: Austin ISD figures, via Austin Current
